info.name: Personal Shortcut
info.description:
REST API of the Personal Shortcut Django app.

**Quick start**
1. Import this collection and the *Personal Shortcut — Local* environment, then select the environment.
2. Start the server (`python3 manage.py runserver`).
3. Fill `userEmail` / `userPassword` in the environment, run **Users → Login** (or Signup) — the token is stored automatically.
4. Run **Expenses → Create expense** to set `pageId`, then Update / Split / Delete.

Only `/api/users/me/` and `/api/users/logout/` require the bearer token; the other `/api/<app>/` routes are open by design.

item.name: Users (token auth)

request.description: Creates an account and returns `user`, `token`, `expires_at`. The token is saved to the `token` environment variable. Email addresses on the owner allow-list must use Google sign-in instead (409). Closed when SIGNUP_ENABLED=False (403).
Phone-number account. A bare 10-digit number is assumed to be +91.
`identifier` is an email or a phone number. Returns a fresh bearer token (one per device). 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (429).
Returns the account for the bearer token.
Revokes the token being sent.
Revokes every token for the account.

item.description: Bearer-token API. Send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Signup/Login save the token to the environment automatically.

item.name: Pick-lists (categories · sources · modes)

request.description: The categories, sources and modes this account has saved, each with `id`, `name` and `uses` (how many expenses use it). The first category id is saved to `optionId`.

Saves a value to the list (201). Adding one that already exists, in any letter case, is a no-op that returns 200. New values are also saved automatically whenever an expense is created or edited with them.
Set `optionKind` to categories, sources or modes. The new name is carried onto every expense that uses the old one (`expenses_updated` in the reply). 409 if the new name already exists.
Removes it from the list only. Expenses already saved with the value keep it; it stops being offered until it is used again.
